title: Advance Tax Calculator
shortAnswer: Calculate your quarterly advance tax installments.
longAnswer: Advance tax is the income tax you pay in instalments during the financial year rather than as a lump sum at the end. It applies to anyone whose total tax liability for the year is ₹10,000 or more after adjusting TDS, including freelancers, businesses, and salaried people with large interest or capital gains income. The instalments are 15% by 15 June, 45% by 15 September, 75% by 15 December, and 100% by 15 March. Taxpayers under the presumptive scheme (44AD/44ADA) pay a single instalment by 15 March. Missing an instalment attracts interest under Section 234C, and paying less than 90% of the total liability by year-end attracts 234B. The calculator takes your estimated annual tax and shows the amount due at each date. It is an estimate—confirm your final liability in the e-filing portal's tax computation before paying.
